interpretations: For each `budget.link_to_event`, average its non-null `spent` and `remaining` values separately; subtract the average of all non-null `budget.remaining` values from its average remaining; return the 10 largest differences in descending order, with null differences last and no rounding.

For each `budget.link_to_event`, average its non-null `spent` and `remaining` values separately; subtract the unweighted average of the events’ average remaining values from its average remaining; return the 10 largest differences in descending order, with null differences last and no rounding.

For each non-null `budget.link_to_event`, average its non-null `spent` and `remaining` values separately; subtract the average of non-null `budget.remaining` values from budget lines linked to an event; return the 10 largest differences in descending order, with null differences last and no rounding.
queries:
SELECT
    link_to_event,
    AVG(spent) AS avg_spent,
    AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining,
    AVG(remaining) - (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget) AS difference
FROM budget
GROUP BY link_to_event
ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event,
        AVG(spent) AS avg_spent,
        AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
)
SELECT
    link_to_event,
    avg_spent,
    avg_remaining,
    avg_remaining - (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM event_averages) AS difference
FROM event_averages
ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
    link_to_event,
    AVG(spent) - AVG(remaining) AS difference
FROM budget
WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY link_to_event
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
